title: Laurel's House of Horror

services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: You and your group will experience an entirely unique and challenging escape room experience - hosted in a haunted complex built inside an abandoned movie theater. Escape Rooms are great for friends, families, team-building, and date night. Based on classic 90’s video games, escaping is a fun way to flex your brain muscle. Don’t go to the movies, escape from inside them! Pricing is per person. Watch Video One night only, choose from two escape rooms. Add an interactive haunted house experience with games and a special midnight mayhem. Fireworks at 9:30pm, between the two open sessions.
